config.ghk_ordering: variables permuted by descending |tau_j| (most extreme thresholds first); one Cholesky per locus shared across all candidates, so the uniforms are common random numbers and the RANKING is better determined than either level
config.ghk_bias: GHK is unbiased for the PROBABILITY; log of it is biased DOWNWARD by Jensen. The reported rel_se is the relative standard error of the probability estimate.
config.scope: argmax over the union of the two models' top-10 lists (chain cells + one-variant flips of each model's mode) -- local optimality plus chain dominance, NOT global optimality over 2^k haplotypes.
config.sparse_model: FPS active set from sparsepca_v32.json (job 50782139), loadings refit by the same PFA call v32 uses, so the model scored here is the model v32 selected.

per_locus.support_source: R0 == K asserted against sparsepca_v32.json; support is the full set
